name: The Stacks
description: A trading post on the rooftops above the drowned city. Nothing is bought with money here; everything is weighed.

variants.description: A trading post on the rooftops above the drowned city, and a swimming line strung between two chimneys with a queue of children on it. Nothing is bought with money here; everything is weighed.
A trading post on the rooftops, thinner than it should be. The causeway generation stopped coming north a decade before the water did, and their grandchildren are not here.
